controls.native_teacher: Frozen P128 over supplied context sentences only; no question/options/answers
controls.features: Union of candidate POS and morphemes, train-only feature vocabulary
controls.graph: Only G0 conditional consensus edges, both directions; no default modification
controls.shuffled: Nonzero cyclic permutation of all edge endpoints per episode; preserves type counts and degree multiset
controls.future_context: Full context is supplied before answering. This is conditional QA; annotations must NOT be used for causal LM perplexity on the same context.

primary: Equal-weight lexical/order/composition held-out synthetic episode accuracy averaged over 3 fixed seeds
limitations: Agent-authored procedural examples, not independent human gold or general Turkish understanding evaluation
Relational native input exposes information close to task answers; system-level mechanism gain, not standalone model understanding
BPE baseline is identical Qwen byte-level BPE, not the smaller historical P56 tokenizer
Native scope: affirmative active past, explicit subject/Acc object and optional Gen possessor; no negation/passive/general subordinate sentence coverage
Structured-query native upper bound is given generator query routing; not natural-language QA system
CI conditions on three fixed training seeds; not a full estimate of seed-population variance
source_protocol_edits_after_start: Refuse resume; create a new version instead
oom_policy: Fail with checkpoint retained; do not silently alter batch/precision/protocol
stop: Ctrl+C checkpoint at next completed optimizer step; emergency kill replays since latest completed checkpoint
